subject: Module-Config: fix a possibility of of a double free (#149)
reason: The fix changes ConfigBuilder (vmsdk/src/module_config.h) to hold its ConfigBase in a shared_ptr from construction instead of wrapping a raw pointer in a new shared_ptr inside Build(). The double free it prevents requires Build() to be called twice on one builder (two independent shared_ptr control blocks), but the builder's copy/assignment are deleted and every call site — the five static config definitions in src/valkey_search_options.cc and the unit tests — calls Build() exactly once on a temporary builder chain.
